description: The file is an HTML document that serves as the frontend for a database visualization web application, including UI layout, styling, and client-side JavaScript logic for interacting with a backend API to browse and display database tables and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a specific database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table, limiting to 50 records.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates and inserts an HTML table for displaying data records.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell values, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses content within a table cell for viewing full data.
